questions.prompt: From literal detail to a defensible inference — Which principle best applies to inference?
options: An inference needs connected textual evidence and must not invent an unseen event.
Naming a technique alone establishes the meaning and the audience’s response.
An interpretation can invent missing events if they make its argument persuasive.
A self-review score proves how a teacher will assess the response.
questions.explanation: An inference needs connected textual evidence and must not invent an unseen event. Test it through the supplied models and your own evidence.
